retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic night-time urban scene featuring a lowrider car in motion with flying currency and searchlight helicopters.
triggerTerms: lowrider car night scene with searchlights
gritty city street art with flying money

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, airbrushed illustration of a classic lowrider cruising through a dark city at night, illuminated by its own underglow and police searchlights from above, with currency notes fluttering in the air.
coreVisualRelationships: Lowrider car as the central dynamic subject
Helicopters and searchlights creating diagonal light beams
Flying money adding chaotic movement to the mid-ground
Heavy yellow typography anchored to the top-left corner
coreInvariants: Dramatic low-angle perspective of the vehicle
Vibrant yellow underglow reflecting on the asphalt
Deep purple and blue night sky contrasting with bright yellow elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large lowrider car dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled diagonally from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright yellow typography in the top-left corner and the glowing yellow light under the car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the car's motion from left to right, then moves upward along the searchlight beams to the helicopters and typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark sky in the upper right provides breathing room for the helicopters and flying money.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and black for the night sky and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for the typography and car underglow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burgundy for the car body and green for the flying currency.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow highlights against very low value, dark backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to high-contrast urban night tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif and distressed woodblock styles
letterConstructionRules: Top text uses ultra-heavy, tightly kerned block letters with a target-like 'O'
Bottom text uses a vertically elongated, distressed stencil or woodblock texture
All primary text is rendered in flat, high-visibility yellow
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' in the top line contains a concentric circle/dot motif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a clean, heavy geometric block font with a tall, distressed, textured display font.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy blocky feel of the top text
Matches the verticality and texture of the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration of a burgundy lowrider car at night on a city street. Include yellow underglow, searchlights from helicopters in a dark purple sky, and flying dollar bills.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold yellow block text in the top left corner, and vertically elongated distressed yellow text below it.

verificationChecks: Is the car a lowrider with underglow?
Are there searchlights and helicopters present?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos on the car
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the yellow text is the brightest element
Check that the car perspective is low and aggressive
Verify the presence of the 'target' motif in the typography
Confirm the airbrushed texture is visible across the image
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Night Airbrush + Lowrider Subject + High-Contrast Yellow Block Typography
